summary: VeriSign filed an 8-K reporting a registered offering of $550M 5.100% Senior Notes due 2031, priced at par via an underwriting agreement with J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, and U.S. Bancorp. Net proceeds of ~$545M plus cash on hand will redeem its outstanding 4.750% Senior Notes due 2027—a pure refinancing. The notes are issued under a base indenture supplemented by a third supplemental indenture. No activist, M&A, or capital-return event; routine debt capital markets activity.
